negative_reviews.author: Alex B
negative_reviews.text:
The ramen was tasty, although left sorta cost-saving feeling - putting literally 2 pieces of pork and few bambuses into bowl is kinda cheap.
But the worst is a shady practice of adding a 10% tip to the receipt without even asking the client. This is considering the poor service (we were sitting for 10 minutes with empty plates on our tables). Had to call 3 different waiters that we want a receipt.
